name: menta
description: Buy, order and book at online stores worldwide, paying with your own card only from spending limits you approve yourself
shortDescription: Shopping and checkout at online stores

setup.notice: Menta pays only from spending limits you approve on Menta's site. Devin can't approve, create or raise one, and card details never go through chat.
steps: Sign in to Menta and add a card and a delivery address
Approve a spending limit on Menta's site, or the one Devin requests when a checkout reaches payment
